title: Dirty Deeds
description: Add the following to your Roguish Skills. See the Rogue Starting Move, **Tricks of the Trade**.

submoves.title: Sneak Attack
submoves.description: When you **Trade Blows**, if your opponent is distracted or unaware of you, and you aren't wearing medium or heavy armor (or a shield), and using a **precise** weapon,

outcomes.text: You can choose to suffer min dmg for free.

title: Always a Way Out
description: When **you're in too deep and look for a way out**, roll+dex.

outcomes.text: You and your allies are gone.
You need to leave something behind; the GM will say what.
It was a trick or a trap; mark 1 XP and the GM makes a Move.

title: Backstab
description: When you **ambush a surprised or defenseless opponent with a** **precise** **weapon**, roll+dex.

bullets: Their armor is reduced by 1 until they repair it
You create a fleeting opportunity; you or an ally get **adv** to your or their next roll

outcomes.text: They were ready; mark 1 XP and the GM makes a Move.

title: Poisoncraft
description: You get **adv** to **Defy Danger** against poison. You also get a poisoner's kit. Mark to produce a poison on the spot and then choose two from the following:

bullets: it can be delivered by touch (otherwise it's ingestion)
it takes effect exactly when you want
it's as strong as you wanted

title: Shadowmancy
description: You can **Cast a Spell**+dex to manipulate shadows around you (but not create them). On a 7-9, you can draw unwanted attention to you instead of the other options. Examples include:

bullets: create shadow knives 1d4 dmg **hand** **close** **piercing** **precise**. If you **Trade Blows** with one in each hand, roll dmg with **adv**
move from shadow to shadow in a single step
shrink, grow, or reshape nearby shadows
